اغتنما (form VIII)
# اِغْتَنَمَا (iḡtanamā) /iɣ.ta.na.maː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# اُغْتُنِمَا (uḡtunimā) /uɣ.tu.ni.maː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# اِغْتَنِمَا (iḡtanimā) /iɣ.ta.ni.maː/: second-person dual imperative of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
